name: sdlc
description: Universal SDLC orchestrator with stack provider auto-discovery. Owns the pipeline AND the whole 12-agent roster (ADR-0021): business-analyst (Opus), developer, reviewer, tester, qa-engineer (Sonnet, iteration caps), security-analyst (Opus, read-only), document-writer (Haiku), debugger (read-only), devops, cicd, aar-analyst, session-recorder. Plugins register via manifest.yaml (kind: foundation | framework) and supply per-role expertise (role_expertise) rendered into each agent's prefix; on-demand agents fetch it via `resolve/cli.mjs expertise --role`. Slash command: /sdlc:start "<feature>".
